sinbad_intro_1.text: So, you came all this way to meet me. How flattering.

sinbad_intro_2.text: Let me show you what the King of the Seven Seas can do.

sinbad_intro_3.text: An adventure at last. Shall we begin?

sinbad_equip_baal_1.text: Spirit of Wrath and Heroes, Baal! Dwell in my body: Djinn Equip!

sinbad_equip_valefor_1.text: Spirit of Falsehood and Confidence, Valefor! Dwell in my body!

sinbad_equip_zepar_1.text: Spirit of Spirit and Puppetry, Zepar! Dwell in my body!

sinbad_equip_focalor_1.text: Spirit of Control and Obedience, Focalor! Dwell in my body!

sinbad_equip_focalor_2.text: Focalor, carry me on the wind!

sinbad_equip_vepar_1.text: Vepar! Dwell in my body, and draw every blade to me!

sinbad_equip_vepar_2.text: Vepar, rain steel on my enemies.

sinbad_equip_crocell_1.text: Crocell! Dwell in my body, and let your light cut through!

sinbad_equip_furfur_1.text: Furfur! Dwell in my body, and tear the darkness open!

sinbad_unequip_1.text: That is enough of that, for now.

sinbad_sword_2.text: A simple blade is enough for you.

sinbad_magoi_1.text: Your magic means nothing to me. Magoi Manipulation.

sinbad_magoi_2.text: I will take that power from you.

sinbad_inqerad_2.text: Stand in the light, or be struck down!

sinbad_scream_1.text: Look away, if you value your mind!

sinbad_crocell_saber_1.text: Three cuts, and not one you will see.

sinbad_orrery_1.text: Seven djinn, seven lights. Fly, my Rukh!

sinbad_orrery_2.text: The Rukh love me. Let them show you.

sinbad_sigil_1.text: This circle is my kingdom. Choose where you stand.

sinbad_sigil_2.text: Only the dark is safe here.

sinbad_foresight_2.text: The flow of destiny never lies.

sinbad_gates_1.text: Enough games. I will use every djinn I have.

sinbad_gates_2.text: Do not make me regret taking you seriously.

sinbad_low_hp_1.text: Not yet. A king never kneels first.

sinbad_low_hp_2.text: My Household would never forgive me for losing here.

sinbad_taunt_1.text: Is that all? Come, impress me.

sinbad_taunt_2.text: You fight well. Almost as well as I sail.

sinbad_taunt_3.text: Do not stop now. I am just warming up.

sinbad_player_death_2.text: Rest well. The sea remembers brave ones.

sinbad_victory_1.text: The Seven Seas are mine. Try again someday.

sinbad_victory_2.text: A fine fight. Go home and train.

sinbad_defeat_1.text: Well fought. The sea has taken me, this time.

sinbad_defeat_2.text: You are stronger than I judged. I will not forget it.

sinbad_defeat_3.text: So this is how a king falls. Worth it.
